title: Reproducibility Artifact for Auditable Policy-Governed LLM-Agent Control for O-RAN Edge Security
description: Frozen reproducibility artifact for the IEEE TNSM manuscript "Auditable Policy-Governed LLM-Agent Control for O-RAN Edge Security." It contains the frozen synthetic-policy oracle, external LangGraph and open-weights baselines, prompt-injection experiment, analysis scripts, hash manifests, and manuscript-support evidence. The artifact does not claim production O-RAN actuation, completed independent human validation, or successful row-bound zero-knowledge verification across the retained 240-row matrix.
